mechanic: Visits in the present: the narrator has three hours and five places to go, six hours' worth; when the hours are spent the same morning begins again, and what was learned is kept. One visit waits for another the same day, and two are thought of only once an earlier one is read.
note: Spoilers. Written for finding 134: the first version of choices the player character makes in the present.

frame.says: The chart was laid in the office drawer and the office door locked on Sunday at six; on Monday at nine the drawer was empty.

questions.asks: Who took the chart from the harbour office?

rules_out.Captain Dunmore: c.marlow: he was at Marlow from six on Sunday until nine on Monday
rules_out.Amos Trew: c.lent: he was without his key from four on Sunday

clues.says: The office door was locked and its lock not forced.
The door has two keys: the Captain's and the pilot's.
The Captain took the Marlow coach at six on Sunday and came back at nine on Monday.
He lent his key to Silas Finch at four on Sunday and was without it until Monday.
At eight on Sunday night Finch was on the quay by the office steps with the pilot's key in his hand.
He says he was in his bed from seven on Sunday and never stirred out.
